_doc: Spatial-provenance manifest. Enforced by .claude/scripts/check-layer-colocation.sh (wired into ./dev.sh --check-encoding and encoding-loop.yml CI). Four gates: (1) every served web/public/maps/*.geojson must be declared in `layers`; (2) any `comparisons` head-to-head must be co-located (bbox IoU >= min_iou); (3) each reach's defined vs imaged extent must reconcile (IoU >= reach_min_iou) OR carry a discrepancy_ack; (4) a reach whose NAME implies a morphology (arroyo/wash/...) that conflicts with its declared `morphology` must carry a discrepancy_ack. Rationale + the failure this prevents: docs/2026-08-21-reach-provenance-gap.md.

malpais.name: Malpais Arroyo–San Juan
malpais.discrepancy_ack: RETRACTED 2026-08-21: the imaged windows cover only the southern San Juan valley; the defined reach extends ~6 km north (up the wash) and the arroyo was never imaged or scored. Name says 'Arroyo' but the geometry is river-dominated. See docs/2026-08-21-reach-provenance-gap.md.

kirtland.name: Kirtland — San Juan mainstem
kirtland.discrepancy_ack: FLAGGED for review 2026-08-21: imaged extent is materially smaller than the defined AOI (defined-vs-imaged IoU ~0.40, imaged north edge ~4 km short). Needs the same truth/model overlay scrutiny as Malpais before any per-reach claim is restated.

web/public/maps/fm_malpais.geojson.note: renders the San Juan mainstem within the mislabeled reach

comparisons.name: bloomfield-truth-rf-fm
comparisons.note: The honest RF-vs-FM head-to-head: expert truth + RF + FM, genuinely co-located.

selftest_expected_fail.name: malpais-rf-vs-fm (RETRACTED — the gate MUST flag this)
selftest_expected_fail.note: The 2026-08-21 retraction: rf_malpais (~-108.71) and fm_malpais (~-108.76) shown as one reach but ~5 km apart. If this ever passes co-location, the gate is broken.
